intent: Feature section for an analytics product: a hairline bento grid of six tiles, each with a live illustration built in markup.

layout.header: 12-col: eyebrow + heading (7 cols), intro + link bottom-aligned (5 cols)
layout.grid: gap-px on ink/9% background, 1px border, radius 22px; tiles #fbfaf8, square corners
layout.tile: padding 24/32px; mono label, 22-24px display title, 15px body; illustration pushed down with mt-auto

stat.unit: about a third of the number's size

motion.trend: clipPath rect reveals the line over 1.6s (not pathLength); d morphs over 0.9s; metrics rotate every 4.2s until clicked
motion.stat: count 0 to value over 1.6s; comparison bars 0.4s and 2.4s linear
motion.search: types at 38-88ms per char, holds the answer 2.6s, deletes 3 chars per 18ms, next query
motion.alerts: a switch flips every 1.7s until the user touches one; spring knob (600/34); preview message follows the watched switch
motion.map: rings r 1.6 to 7, fading over 2.4s, staggered; random city pops and counts tick every 1.1s; top-4 list re-sorts with layout
motion.staging: entrances play only for tiles at least 30% on screen at mount or approaching later; otherwise render the finished state
motion.reducedMotion: final states, no loops, no typing, no counting

responsive.mobile: single column; segmented control wraps under the title; map shows its total under the title; top cities in 2 columns
responsive.md: 2 columns; trend and map full width

accessibility: section aria-labelledby the h2; tiles are articles with h3s
metric buttons use aria-pressed; settings rows are role=switch buttons with aria-checked, 60px tall
typing animation aria-hidden, with an sr-only list of queries and answers
heatmap and map are role=img with descriptive labels

content.heading: Analytics that / answer back.
tiles: Rhythm: Know when they show up
Ask: Ask it like you'd ask a person
queries: why did churn spike on tuesday?
